# Ottawa Garage Door Repair

> Ottawa Garage Door Repair is an Ottawa-based garage door repair and installation company (also known as Garage Door Repair Ottawa). We provide same-day garage door services including spring replacement, opener repair, cable repair, and new door installation across all Ottawa neighbourhoods. Licensed, insured; we arrive in under 90 minutes and offer 24/7 emergency service.

## Contact

- **Phone:** (613) 617-4238
- **Email:** info@ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca
- **Address:** Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
- **Website:** https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca

## Services

We offer the following garage door services in Ottawa:

- [Spring Replacement](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/spring-replacement) — Torsion and extension springs; same-day
- [Opener Repair & Installation](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/opener-repair) — All major brands serviced
- [Opener Gear Replacement](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/opener-gear-replacement) — Drive gear and motor repair
- [24/7 Emergency Repair](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/emergency-repair) — Under 90 minutes across Ottawa
- [New Door Installation](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/new-door-installation) — Steel, wood, glass, and insulated doors
- [Cable Repair](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/cable-repair) — Both lift cables replaced safely
- [Panel Repair](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/panel-repair) — Dent and damage repair
- [Weatherstripping & Insulation](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/weatherstripping) — Bottom seal and weather stripping
- [Maintenance Tune-Up](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services/maintenance-tune-up) — 21-point inspection and tune-up

[View all services](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/services)

## Service Area

We serve Ottawa and 37 surrounding areas within about 40 minutes' drive, including Kanata, Barrhaven, Nepean, Orleans, Stittsville, Gloucester, Manotick, Embrun, Russell, Metcalfe, Kemptville, Arnprior, Almonte, Rockland, Smiths Falls, and more.

- [All service areas](https://www.ottawagaragedoorrepair.ca/areas)

## Key Information

- **Response time:** Under 90 minutes everywhere in Ottawa
- **Hours:** Same-day service 7 days a week; 24/7 emergency
- **Warranty:** 1 year on repairs; 5 years on new door installation
- **Quotes:** Written quote approved before any work starts; no surprise add-ons
- **Licensed & insured:** Ontario licensed; $2 million liability
